digest.component_or_area: LLM prompt caching and cache-control marker placement in plan-review gate
propositions: Prompt cache breakpoint placement after pass-specific stance suffixes causes zero cross-pass reads within a single plan-review run, despite byte-identical shared plan-bearing prefix shared across passes.
Single-turn plan-review passes write premium-rate cache tokens (~9-10k per review) that are never read, incurring 5-6k token-equivalent pure waste per review.

Cache-control marker in pydantic-ai marks the last static system block; moving shared_plan_prefix to static system_prompt and pass-specific stance to dynamic instruction relocates breakpoint to shared-prefix boundary.
Diagnostic warn_if_cache_ineffective only fires when write==0 AND read==0, missing the write-every-call/read-0 pattern where writes are pure loss.
Cross-ticket prefix identity is unsatisfiable without evicting plan from marked prefix, which breaks within-run container/chunk reuse that warm-then-fan-out depends on.
